title: The Last Dance
text: Music drifts from a ruined ballroom, a waltz from another age, and ghosts are dancing among the fallen chandeliers, in gowns of mist and coats of dust. They turn and turn. One of them stops, and holds out a hand to the party's most troubled soul.

options.label: The most troubled takes the ghost's hand, longing for one moment of grace.

outcomes.text: One dance, slow and cold, and they come out lighter.
One dance, and then another, and another, and they cannot stop, and the ghosts do not want them to.

options.label: Everyone dances, and the dead have company for one more night.

outcomes.text: It is a very long night among the dead, and a good one, and your feet ache at dawn.

options.label: Leave them to their ball. The dead have their own music.

outcomes.text: The music follows you to the edge of the ruin, and the Leader keeps wondering what the dance would have been.
